items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 129:1
items.html: The GAR of Beriah, which are from the Mochin of SAG of Ima, are not actual GAR, but only the aspect of the power of the GAR of Ima. For the screen in the Parsa, upon which these Mochin came out, already cut off from them the illumination of Atzilut, which is the essence of the GAR of Ima, and therefore only the power of the GAR of Ima remained in them. (Item 201).
